title: DGFT Notification 74/2025-26: RoDTEP scheme rates extended to 30 September 2026
body_text: In exercise of powers under the Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992, the existing RoDTEP rates and the RoSCTL scheme rates are extended till 30.09.2026, unless withdrawn earlier. Notification No. 74/2025-26, dated 15 August 2026.

title: Govt extends RoDTEP and RoSCTL export incentive rates till September 30, 2026
body_text: The Department of Commerce today announced an extension of the RoDTEP and RoSCTL scheme rates to 30 September 2026, providing continuity for exporters as the government finalises the next phase of the scheme.

title: RoDTEP, RoSCTL rates extended to Sept 30: what exporters should know
body_text: Exporters welcomed the government's move to extend RoDTEP and RoSCTL rates to 30 September 2026, though industry bodies flagged uncertainty about what happens after the deadline given the scheme's reduced FY27 budget allocation.

title: RoDTEP rate extension buys exporters six more months of certainty
body_text: The extension of RoDTEP rates to September 30, 2026 gives textile and engineering goods exporters short-term relief, though the scheme's FY27 budget allocation was cut nearly 45% versus FY26, raising questions about post-extension rates.

title: RBI notifies FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026, effective 1 October 2026
body_text: The Reserve Bank of India has notified the FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026, which come into effect from 1 October 2026. The regulations reset the export realisation period to 9 months from the date of shipment, unified the EDF/EDPMS filing process, and introduced a set-off mechanism for import and export dues.

title: Oleoresin Paprika From India: Final Affirmative Countervailing Duty Determination
body_text: The Department of Commerce determines that countervailable subsidies, including benefits under India's RoDTEP scheme, are being provided to producers and exporters of oleoresin paprika from India. Final CVD rates range from 5.68% to 25.29%, published 21 August 2026.

title: US finalises countervailing duty on Indian oleoresin paprika, cites RoDTEP subsidy
body_text: The US Commerce Department's final countervailing duty determination on oleoresin paprika from India specifically names RoDTEP as a countervailable subsidy program, a pattern spice exporters should watch across other CVD cases.

title: WTO members discuss trade monitoring report amid rising trade restrictions
body_text: The WTO's latest trade monitoring report notes a continued rise in trade-restrictive measures among G20 economies, with new import restrictions and technical regulations affecting a broad range of sectors.

title: DGFT Trade Notice: Clarification on e-scrip validity and transfer for RoSCTL duty credit
body_text: This trade notice clarifies that e-scrips issued under RoSCTL remain valid for one year from the date of issue and can be transferred once via ICEGATE, subject to the transferee's GSTIN being active.

title: Monsoon session: Parliament to discuss Export Promotion Mission outlay
body_text: The government's Rs 25,060 crore Export Promotion Mission is expected to be discussed in the monsoon session, with MSME exporters seeking clarity on disbursal timelines.
